name: comp-580
title: Ecommerce Search Navbar
description: A dark ecommerce top bar with a starburst logo, Products, Categories and Deals links, a search field with a magnifier, a Sign In action and a white Cart button showing a count.
use: An online store needs search and a cart always visible in the top bar.
avoid: Search is a plain field with no suggestions, and categories are fixed links with no dropdown.
a11y: The search field relies on its placeholder rather than a label, and the logo link has no accessible name. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark header bar with a starburst logo, three small category links, a rounded search field with a magnifier icon, a plain Sign In button and a white rounded Cart pill holding a faint 2.
behaves: Typing in the search box highlights its border and shows the query with a native clear button, while the rest of the bar stays still. The category links and buttons only react on hover.
customise: The logo, three category labels, cart count and search placeholder are fixed copy inside the file; colours follow theme tokens.
weight: light: A row of links, one input and two buttons.
